name: @fpay/app
_comment: The product: the store, the backend client, the sheets and the components every app that IS fpay renders — web and mobile. Source-only like @fpay/ui (consumers transpile it). What a platform does differently (storage, the in-app browser, share, clipboard, foreground events, env) goes through ONE seam, src/platform.ts, which each app fills in with configure() at boot. Import the barrel from native code.
